definitions.gloss: first half; first half of a fiscal year; first half of a business period
definitions.explanation: The first half of a fiscal year or accounting period. In Japan, where the fiscal year typically runs April to March, the first half is April to September.

examples.japanese: {上期|かみき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧。
{上期|かみき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{好調|こうちょう}→好調：12209_kouchou⟧だった。

{上期|かみき}⟦{決算|けっさん}→決算：05973_kessan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、{通期|つうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見通|みとお}し→見通し：10566_mitooshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上方|じょうほう}{修正|しゅうせい}→上方修正：24821_jouhoushuusei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Based on the first-half earnings results, the full-year outlook was revised upward.

notes: A business term. In Japan, most companies and the government use a fiscal year running from April to March, so {上期|かみき} is April–September. Also read as じょうき in some contexts. Common collocations: {上期|かみき}⟦{決算|けっさん}→決算：05973_kessan⟧ (first-half earnings), {上期|かみき}⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧ (first-half results). The opposite is ⟦{下期|しもき}→下期：18679_shimoki⟧ (second half of the fiscal year, October–March). Related: {通期|つうき} (full year), ⟦{四半期|しはんき}→四半期：10103_shihanki⟧ (quarter).
